summary_on_commit.description: "1": every head move of the main line gets a new summary; "0": only the birth of a file does (a failed birth summary is retried on the next head move either way). Embeddings follow `embed` alone.

embed.description: "1": every head move embeds the file section by section; "0": nothing is embedded, and `search` semantic and `ask` answer `not_indexed`.

ask_sections.description: How many sections, best first, `ask` hands the summarizer (plus at most one exact hit of the question's words).

section_lines.description: Window of a section in lines where no heading or page cuts the text (10 lines overlap); at most 400 sections a file, above that the windows grow.

description.purpose: What a file knows about itself, from its birth on (GH #903): after every head move of the main line it cuts the text view of the new version into sections, embeds them through `./embed`, has `./summarizer` write a one-line and a short summary, and writes `summaries`, `embeddings` and `files.oneline`. It answers `search` with mode `semantic` and `ask` -- the one operation of the hive that asks a model -- out of the embeddings of the one file and version asked about.
description.use_when: Inside `file-space` only: behind `./write` (and `./ws` on a commit) on `in_derive`, and behind the hive's `in_read` for `ask` and semantic `search`.
description.not_in_scope: No write of a file, no working version (they get nothing), no entities (Bau C), no model or endpoint of its own: `./embed` and `./summarizer` are the only doors out, and only this cell opens them.
description.emits_meaning: derive_store: store operations, every one with `file` in its `where`, answered back on `cur_origin` `derive`. embed: texts to embed (the sections, or the question). summarize: the summary brief or the `ask` brief with the chosen lines. answer: exactly one answer per `in_read` request, `op`, `op_id`, `caller` mirrored. derived: `{file, version, ok, oneline}` after an `in_derive` that carried `notify` "1" (also on failure), `caller` mirrored.
description.consumes_meaning: in_derive `{file, version}` (hop `notify`, `caller`), in_read `{op, file, args}` for `ask` and semantic `search`, `embedded` from `./embed`, `in_summary` from `./summarizer`, and the store's answers to its phases. A failed embedding or summary writes nothing and leaves the rows there are; the next head move tries again.
